text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hah, hah, hah, hah—!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
More, even more...!
My limit is still! So much! So much further away—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From the day she decided to enter the "Laurel Cup,"
Agnes Tachyon broke new records
every single day.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Tachyon's always been fast, but
hasn't she been totally insane lately!?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
She's totally fired up!
Can't wait for the Laurel Cup!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Running across the grounds as if freed from a heavy burden, the figure racing away was truly that of an awakened genius.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Phew...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I suppose so. It's written all over your face.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, her sudden change
also left me feeling bewildered.
choice_data_list: Still... what brought this on all of a sudden?
Still... what brought this on all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If I had to put it in words, I simply made a "choice."
You'd do the same, wouldn't you? It's nothing special.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—Now then, let's go for one more run!
Make sure to time me accurately!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...At any rate, it was clear that
Agnes Tachyon had undergone a major change of heart.
choice_data_list: (Supporting her is my duty as her Trainer!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That night, seeing her so motivated for
the Laurel Cup, I pondered what I could
do to help her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There must be something
that only a Trainer can do.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Opening the "Laurel Cup" entry list
and past records one after another—
before I knew it, dawn had broken.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Weather, track condition, habits, other competitors,
their personalities, family relations, rivals,
favorite courses, least favorite courses...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"You did this in one night...?
Which means, you haven't slept, have you?"
choice_data_list: I just kind of got carried away...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Kukuku, are you really that thrilled
to see me motivated, hmm?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—Even so, looking at this detailed data!
It should be really useful for the Laurel Cup!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's an important race where we can gather precious data.
We must make every preparation we can!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying so, Agnes Tachyon
gazed intently at the data.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hm-? What's made you look so pleased with yourself?
choice_data_list: Is there anything else I can do?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Whoa, whoa! You're really fired up, aren't you!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I see, well then...
Could you let me lock you up for about ten days?
It's absolutely vital for an experiment, you see. Hehehe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If it means I can witness her limits,
I replied before I could even think.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I'll even drink Umamusume medicine again."
"I'll go along with any experiment."
I offered every possible proposal I could think of—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh, hahaha...! You're out of your mind!
Locking you up was a joke! That's against the law, you know?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Haa, but still... Hehehe...!
I cannot help but wonder what could possibly drive such a thing!
choice_data_list: (Seeing them like that, how could I not...?!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I tried to convey her charm when she gives it her all,
but the right words just wouldn't come to mind.
choice_data_list: (The way she looked out on the track...)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
More, even more...!
My limit is still! So much! So much further away—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The dust, the footsteps, the retreating back.
It all radiated light, completely captivating me—
choice_data_list: I want to do whatever I can for her!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...What?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If it's to go beyond our limits together with you."
When I followed up with that, she fell unusually silent.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"‘If it's to go beyond our limits together with you.’
When I followed up with that, she fell uncharacteristically silent."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...What's that about?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, I see!
...You haven't changed a bit, have you?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: "I want to see 'the end' together with you too."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: "I want to see the 'end' together, too."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"...You said something similar
back when you scouted me, didn't you?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
That was the day you drank three bottles of bizarrely colored medicine
just to become my Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Heh heh, hahaha!
That was quite a shock, that was.
I thought to myself, what an impressive guinea pig.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Her eyes narrowed fondly, reminiscing about the past.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Back then, bathed in the setting sun,
your eyes held a truly maddened gaze.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: —No, that's not right. Let me correct that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With those words, Agnes Tachyon fixed her gaze steadily upon me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Even now...
"Your eyes have quite a mad glint in them."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...I have a habit of being drawn to peculiar things, you see.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...And with that, she let out a quiet sigh.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, and I had just steeled my resolve, too.
This couldn't be any more uncool.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
As long as the possibility isn't zero,
it's too early to give up.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Then you will accompany me for further experiments, my dear Guinea Pig.
choice_data_list: What are you even talking about?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Half of the trouble that's about to happen is going to be your fault.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And on that day, she skipped training
for the first time in three weeks.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The next day—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Trainer-kun. I have something to tell you. It's good news.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Participation in the "Laurel Cup" is cancelled.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Without going into detail...
she holed herself up in the lab once again."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, as declared,
she withdrew from the Laurel Cup—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon's abrupt, unilateral decision
ended up being widely reported everywhere.
